name: Robot_MACD
summary: This EA trades based on MACD signal line crossovers, entering long positions when MACD crosses above its signal line and short positions when it crosses below. It uses fixed lot sizing and implements basic stop loss and take profit levels for trade management. The strategy is a classic momentum-following approach relying on MACD histogram direction changes for trade signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MACD信号线交叉进行交易，当MACD上穿信号线时做多，下穿信号线时做空。使用固定手数下单，并设置基本的止损和止盈水平进行仓位管理。策略属于经典的动量跟踪方法，依赖MACD柱状图方向变化产生交易信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用经典的MACD交叉策略作为核心交易逻辑，利用移动平均收敛散度指标的趋势跟踪特性捕捉中期动量变化。入场条件为MACD主线与信号线发生交叉：MACD从下方穿越信号线时开多单，从上方穿越信号线时开空单。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈水平，部分版本可能包含MACD反向交叉平仓逻辑。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户资金动态调整仓位大小。资金管理方面较为薄弱，缺乏最大持仓限制、最大回撤控制和资金比例下单机制。整体策略逻辑简单明了，但在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs the classic MACD crossover strategy as its core trading logic, leveraging the trend-following characteristics of the Moving Average Convergence Divergence indicator to capture medium-term momentum shifts. Entry conditions are based on MACD main line crossing the signal line: a long position is opened when MACD crosses above the signal line, and a short position when it crosses below. Exit conditions rely on predefined stop loss and take profit levels, with some implementations potentially including a MACD reverse crossover exit mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or risk percentage. Money management is relatively weak, lacking maximum position limits, maximum drawdown controls, and equity-proportional sizing mechanisms. The overall strategy logic is simple and clear, but it is prone to generating frequent false signals during ranging or choppy market conditions, leading to consecutive losses.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证
MACD是经过长期验证的经典动量指标，理论基础扎实
设有止损和止盈，具备基本的风险控制框架
参数可调，用户可根据不同品种和时间周期优化
代码结构通常较为规范，适合作为学习参考
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and verify
MACD is a well-tested classic momentum indicator with solid theoretical foundation
Includes stop loss and take profit, providing a basic risk control framework
Adjustable parameters allow users to optimize for different instruments and timeframes
Code structure is typically well-organized, suitable as a learning reference
cons: 固定手数下单未考虑账户资金比例，风险敞口不可控
MACD在震荡行情中频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上反复开仓
未设置最大持仓限制和最大回撤保护
未考虑点差和滑点对短线交易的影响
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing ignores account equity ratio, making risk exposure uncontrolled
MACD generates frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar
No maximum position limit or maximum drawdown protection implemented
Does not account for spread and slippage impact on short-term trades
improvements: 引入动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和风险比例自动计算手数
添加趋势过滤条件（如ADX或大周期均线）避免震荡行情虚假信号
增加新K线检测机制防止同一根K线重复开仓，并加入点差过滤条件
improvements_en: Introduce dynamic position sizing that automatically calculates lots based on account balance and risk percentage
Add trend filter conditions (such as ADX or higher timeframe moving averages) to avoid false signals in ranging markets
Implement new bar detection to prevent repeated entries on the same bar, and add spread filter conditions

risk_points: 固定手数未与账户资金挂钩，大资金下风险敞口过大
缺乏最大持仓和回撤保护，极端行情下可能造成重大亏损
震荡行情中MACD频繁交叉导致连续止损累积损失
risk_points_en: Fixed lot size not linked to account equity, creating excessive risk exposure with larger accounts
Lacks maximum position and drawdown protection, potentially causing significant losses in extreme markets
Frequent MACD crossovers in ranging markets lead to consecutive stop loss hits and cumulative losses
